notes: The LED on pin 13 is the Uno's built-in LED, so no external LED or resistor is added, as the tutorial's parts list says.

In the image the potentiometer straddles the centre gap. Its two outer legs (GND and 5V) sit in the lower half of the breadboard, in column 10 and column 12. Its wiper leg sits in column 11 of the upper half, and the yellow wire plugs into the same column strip. Using the catalogue's bank naming, the image's lower half (rows a-e) is bank 't' and the upper half (rows f-j) is bank 'b'.
The black wire goes to the second GND pin in the Uno's power header, which I mapped to GND.2.
The potentiometer is shown as a trimmer. I mapped the left leg to GND, the right leg to VCC (5V) and the wiper to SIG. GND and VCC are interchangeable in the catalogue.
